[[File:Geraldo.png|thumb|250px|Geraldo]] '''Geraldo''' (Japanese: '''ヒロカズ''' ''Hirokazu'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. ==History== Geraldo debuted in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]]. His first opponent was [[Cassie]], whom he defeated, advancing himself to the next round. He appeared again in ''[[BW091|Battling Authority Once Again!]]'', where he battled {{Ash}} in the second round and lost. Geraldo made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]], and [[Freddy O'Martian]]. In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Geraldo competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, which indicated that he had made it through the first round. When the screens showed the match-ups for the last sixteen in ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', Geraldo did not appear on it, which meant that he had lost either in the second round or the third round. In ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'', he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Geraldo |pkmn=Reuniclus |img=Geraldo Reuniclus.png |type1=Psychic |epnum=BW090 |epname=Jostling for the Junior Cup! |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Reuniclus}} was the first Pokémon that Geraldo used in the Junior Cup. It was able to defeat Cassie's {{p|Sawsbuck}} and advance its Trainer to the second round. In the second round, Reuniclus went up against [[Ash's Boldore]], who defeated it. Reuniclus's only known move is {{m|Thunder}}.}} Geraldo has at least one other Pokémon, as he participated in the second round of the Vertress Conference which requires a 2 vs 2 Single Battle ==Achievements== ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Geraldo has obtained in the [[Unova]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'') ===Pokémon League=== Geraldo has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Vertress Conference]] - Top 32 / Top 64 (''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'') ===Pokémon competitions=== Geraldo has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] - Top 8 (''[[BW091|Battling Authority Once Again!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color dark}} |ja=坂東孝一 ''Kōichi Bandō'' |en=[[Billy Bob Thompson]] |es_la=Manuel Díaz |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo |fi=Aku Laitinen ([[BW090]])
